prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your needs (residential vs commercial, roof type, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, budget, warranty priorities, and where in Dallas you are).

Quick questions so I can recommend specific, highly rated companies near you:
- Is this a residential or commercial roof?
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Dallas?
- Are you working with an insurance claim?
- Any preferred material (asphalt shingle, metal, tile)?

Until you reply, here are proven steps and what to look for when picking the best roofer:

What to require
- Proof of insurance (general liability + workers’ comp) — verify with the insurer.
- Local registration or permits (some Dallas/DFW cities require registration).
- Manufacturer certifications (e.g., GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed) for better warranties.
- Written, detailed estimate showing scope, materials, removal vs. overlay, ventilation, flashing, permit costs, timeline, payment schedule, and warranty.
- References and recent job photos.

How to choose
- Get at least 3 written estimates and compare scope and materials, not just price.
- Check recent Google/Yelp reviews, BBB rating, and any state/local consumer complaints.
- Ask about instal crews vs. subcontractors and who will manage the project.
- Prefer companies that provide a workmanship warranty in addition to manufacturer warranty.

Red flags
- High-pressure sales tactics or “storm-chaser” promises.
- No insurance or unwillingness to provide a certificate.
- Only verbal estimates or requests for large upfront cash payment.
- No physical business address or poor communication.

If you give me your ZIP code and whether it’s residential or commercial, I’ll pull a short list of top-rated roofing companies in Dallas and highlight each one’s strengths and recent ratings. I can also draft a checklist of questions to ask when you call them.
